groups.label: Outline
groups.description: How the outline of a new shape is drawn.

groups.label: Fill
groups.description: How the inside of a new shape with an area is filled.

dataType.title: Data type
dataType.description: The data type of new shapes until a user chooses one in this browser. It must be an available data type (ADR-0023), else core.general is used.

x-emc2.hint: Until a user chooses one here; an unavailable type gives core.general

outlineColor.title: Outline colour
outlineColor.description: The outline colour of new shapes, as #rrggbb.

outlineWidth.title: Outline width
outlineWidth.description: The outline width of new shapes, in pixels.

outlineDash.title: Outline dash
outlineDash.description: The outline dash of new shapes.

fill.title: Fill
fill.description: The fill of new shapes that have an area: none, transparent (a colour and an opacity) or hatched (diagonal lines in the fill colour).

x-emc2.hint: None, transparent (a colour and an opacity) or hatched (diagonal lines)

fillColor.title: Fill colour
fillColor.description: The fill colour of new shapes when the fill is transparent or hatched, as #rrggbb.

x-emc2.hint: Used when the fill is transparent or hatched, as #rrggbb

fillOpacity.title: Fill opacity
fillOpacity.description: The fill opacity of new shapes when the fill is transparent or hatched, from 0 to 1 (0.2 is 20 %).

x-emc2.hint: Used when the fill is transparent or hatched; 0 to 1, 0.2 is 20 %
